binding_state: Frozen paired replication analysis template; future source pins remain pending until both complete first scores and root release.

analysis_runner.mode: default saved-score path with verified complete-score receipts

method_contract.sign: native dual-store system minus matched direct max512; higher task quality is positive
method_contract.primary_estimand: paired whole-speaker cluster bootstrap delta with 10000 draws, seed 20260913, and two-sided percentile CI90
method_contract.natural_mixture: The primary point estimate and bootstrap use the roster's natural mixture.
method_contract.equal_stratum: Report equal-scenario point deltas separately for every metric; do not replace natural-mixture inference with an equal-stratum average.
method_contract.population_rule: NEW500 remains primary; OLD500 and DEV1000 remain descriptive sensitivity populations. The latter cannot replace the primary result. Do not redraw, filter, reweight, or promote a secondary population.
method_contract.pooled_micro_rule: Compute slu_f1_micro only from saved official word and character TP, FP, and FN sufficient counts. It is not the mean of per-sample F1.
method_contract.row_mean_rule: slu_f1_f1 is the mean per-sample official SLU F1 and is reported as a distinct estimand.
secondary_quality: paired saves, harms, ties, malformed, empty, and saturated final deliveries
method_contract.sensitivity: Report the shared scenario-stratified paired row-bootstrap CI90 alongside the speaker-cluster primary interval. It is a sensitivity, not a replacement primary analysis.

predeclared_advancement.advance_condition: Advance as an exploratory complete-system capability only when the NEW500 official pooled SLU micro F1 speaker-cluster CI90 lower endpoint is greater than zero and the DEV1000 and equal-scenario pooled-micro point deltas are both positive.
predeclared_advancement.meaning: This is an engineering selection rule for bounded exploratory system development, not superiority, generalization, a component-causal claim, or confirmatory inference.
predeclared_advancement.intent_and_regressions: Report intent, scenario, action, slot/entity, malformed, empty, saturation, saves, harms, and ties. They diagnose the next capability but are not arbitrary vetoes of a positive primary quality result.
predeclared_advancement.if_inconclusive: Do not extend or rerun to seek a favorable result. Preserve the paired result and inspect the named complete-system bottleneck using the frozen candidate, role, terminal, tool, and OBS/ORG/SUPPLY/USE diagnostics.
predeclared_advancement.if_harmful: If the primary CI90 is wholly below zero, preserve the result, reverse the prospective step, and root-cause the named complete-system failure before another extension.
predeclared_advancement.next_capability_diagnosis: Compare candidate gold-in-up-to-N coverage with covered-but-final-wrong resolution, correct-intent/entity error partitions, terminal and output failures, and actual role/tool/supply traces. Candidate misses favor a discriminative Perception evidence extension; covered-but-unresolved or correct-intent/entity errors favor Solver evidence-use or slot-resolution work; reliable terminal or format failures require the named reliability repair first. If no diagnostic dominates, hold the next mechanism for root review.
predeclared_advancement.replication_interpretation: Evaluate the unchanged original advancement rule on this fresh pair and report both original and replica. Do not average away a failed replica or repeat for a favorable result.

diagnostics_after_registered_release.candidate: Use the separately frozen native diagnostics template to report gold intent inclusion in the actual unpadded Perception candidate set up to N=3, rank-one correctness, observed width, gold-missing cases, covered-but-final-incorrect cases, final-correct-outside-candidate cases, rank-one-to-final saves and harms, and per-scenario/population tables. These are system-only descriptive diagnostics and never filter the paired direct comparison.
diagnostics_after_registered_release.native_episode: Use analyze_verified_native_episode_statistics over the sealed native bundle to report raw role visits, all model contacts by role, completion caps and stops, Planner action/revision histograms, terminal solver dispositions, native tool events, supplied values, and lexical consumption.
diagnostics_after_registered_release.information_planes: Report OBS, ORG, SUPPLY, and USE counts and provenance when present. Lexical USE/COPY/IGNORE is descriptive overlap only and does not prove semantic or causal use.
diagnostics_after_registered_release.cost: Report model contacts, tool contacts, tokens, speech seconds, latency, fit/generation/scoring windows, and supplied values. Cost and latency are descriptive only and never reject a quality-positive result.

authorization_state: No generation, scoring or quality read is authorized by this recipe. Root must admit the queued pair after current flight closure, bind measured complete manifests and first-score receipts, and release the paired read.

output.source_bindings: Root replaces pending values only with sealed measured artifacts. Do not alter the method, metric order, seed, roster, or advancement rule while binding.

purpose.comparison: One fresh same-setting paired replication of the completed max512 dual-store agent versus its matched direct model.
purpose.native_system: Preserve the completed Perception, Solver, Reviewer task-contract tools and bounded Planner system with the same two knowledge stores.
purpose.direct_system: Preserve the completed shared direct-only phase, full label task, input speech and max512 configuration.
purpose.claim_boundary: Stability of this exact exploratory system on historically exposed discovery; no component causality, held-out generalization or algorithmic policy improvement.
